what: TFI International is a Canadian trucking group: less-than-truckload networks in Canada and the United States, truckload carriers, parcel delivery and logistics brokerage.
customers: Shippers across Canada and the United States, from parcels to full truckloads.
money: pallet freight across terminal networks in both countries
parcel delivery in Canada and brokerage
moat: A Canadian parcel and LTL network with limited competition, combined with an American LTL business bought cheaply from UPS and improved.
risks: American LTL integration has gone slower than promised and margins there lag
Freight volumes have been weak for three years
opportunities: 13.3 times free cash flow with $575M of free cash flow
Analysts see about 40% upside, with 15 covering the stock
The Canadian parcel and LTL business is highly profitable and far steadier than American truckload
watch: The American LTL operating ratio and Canadian segment margins.
